summary.text: Copper dragonfish are a modified dragonfish species Fang Yuan breeds in dragon scale sea area and sells in treasure yellow heaven. They carry more food path dao marks than ordinary dragonfish and show a metallic red-copper luster.

claims.text: Fang Yuan breeds dragonfish in dragon scale sea area with a food path immortal Gu formation drawn from a food path inheritance. Ordinary dragonfish look like large red carps. After many generations under that formation, a superior modified species appears: smaller than normal dragonfish, with dimmer scales that hold a metallic luster resembling red copper. He names the result copper dragonfish and places a portion into treasure yellow heaven.

Gu Immortals treat copper dragonfish as a brand new species with a better effect than ordinary dragonfish, and some deduce that the seller has a food path true inheritance. You Chan tests them and finds a higher proportion of food path dao marks than ordinary stock. She reads the species as a fundamental threat to her dragonfish business, reverse-deduces from a purchased specimen, and recreates copper dragonfish of her own, using his stock as the breeding point.

You Chan later sells copper dragonfish as well. In dragon scale sea area, about thirty percent of Fang Yuan’s stock becomes copper dragonfish while the rest includes ordinary red dragonfish and black ones.
After copper and iron sales, Fairy Zi Wei focuses on the new species, and You Chan with Qin Bai He treat the mysterious seller as having deep food path foundation.
In dragon scale sea area, ordinary dragonfish, copper dragonfish, iron dragonfish, and silver dragonfish all move around an ancient golden dragonfish.

Fang Yuan judges that ordinary, iron, and copper dragonfish have expensive production methods rivals cannot match as easily as his, though copper dragonfish have already been replicated at higher cost.
Heavenly Court later sells copper, iron, and silver dragonfish at heavily reduced prices in treasure yellow heaven, impacting Fang Yuan’s dragonfish business.
